title: Conditional Rank-Rank Regression
abstract: arXiv:2407.06387v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rank-rank regression is commonly employed in economic research as a way of capturing the relationship between two economic variables. The slope of this regression is the Spearman rank correlation, a classical measure of association. However, in many applications it is common practice to include covariates to account for differences in association levels between groups as defined by the values of these covariates. This is either done by including the covariates or by modeling the residuals obtained after partialing out the impact of the covariates. In each of these instances the resulting rank-rank regression coefficients can be difficult to interpret. We propose the conditional rank-rank regression, which uses conditional ranks instead of unconditional ranks, to measure average within-group persistence. translated_abstract: 秩-秩回归在经济研究中常被用来捕捉两个经济变量之间的关系，该回归的斜率即Spearman秩相关系数，这是一种经典的关联性度量方法。然而在许多应用中，人们通常需要纳入协变量，以解释由这些协变量取值所定义的不同组别之间关联水平的差异。这既可以通过直接纳入协变量来实现，也可以通过在剔除协变量影响后对所得残差进行建模来实现。在上述情形下，所得到的秩-秩回归系数往往难以解释。我们提出了条件秩-秩回归，该方法使用条件秩而非无条件秩来衡量组内的平均持续性。这一新回归的系数对应于以协变量为条件的平均Spearman秩相关系数，这是一种自然的……
tldr: 提出条件秩-秩回归方法，通过用条件秩替代无条件秩来衡量组内平均持续性，其系数对应于以协变量为条件的平均Spearman秩相关系数，从而解决了传统秩-秩回归在纳入协变量后系数难以解释的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes conditional rank-rank regression, which uses conditional ranks instead of unconditional ranks to measure average within-group persistence, with its coefficient corresponding to the average Spearman rank correlation conditional on covariates, thereby resolving the interpretability issues of conventional rank-rank regression when covariates are included.
